title: KAITO — A Chat With The Lost〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What? You're leaving already?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yeah. We practiced quite a lot, after all!
And we have to prepare for tomorrow's show, too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Although the Halloween show is over, we still have our regular stage performances to tend to.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Tsukasa, what's your opinion about going around the world? Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't like where this is going, but...tell me more.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, that sounds cool! Tell me more too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Looks like both Rui and Tsukasa are back to their usual selves now. That's great.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO, I'm back!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Welcome back. I saw that you were having a lot of fun with Rui and Tsukasa, hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehehe, they promised to perform together with me the next time they're here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's fantastic. I look forward to that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, I was thinking of asking Rin to join us in the performance too, but does Tsukasa know that Rin is already in this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. I introduced her to them before, and they even did a show together too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I haven't been seeing her around much lately. But I'm sure she's just found somewhere to play by herself in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yup. Probably playing on an attraction somewhere today too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whenever we do meet, she's full of stories to tell about the attractions she's played and plushies she's met!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's why I want to tell her about the shows that I've been doing with you and everyone else too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, I'm glad to hear she's keeping well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: By the way, while I'm inviting her to join this next show, can I invite her to your theatrical troupe too, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: She's really interested in performances and such, so I'm sure she'd jump at the chance to join!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, of course. We would love to have her.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yay! Okay, I'll invite her the next time we meet, then!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Aww, Len's so happy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: He must've been itching to perform together with Rin.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup♪ I can't wait to see them perform together too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Besides, I know you want to see Tsukasa and Rui's show too, now that they've made up with each other, right, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm really so glad to see that Rui has recovered from feeling down.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I bet it was because Tsukasa tried his bestest to help♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. I bet it was!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By thus supporting your friends in what they want to do, and putting smiles on their faces...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene, and Rui are certainly starting to grow and mature together as a troupe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! You can't make lots of people smile if you don't make yourself smile first☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Our smile makes our friends smile, which leads to the smiles of the people watching our shows, and their smiles will, in turn, make us smile as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I hope we can become a troupe that connects the smiles of many people together like that as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Huh? What're you talking about, KAITO?
We already are a troupe that connects smiles together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Every day, we perform happily together on stage, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And when Tsukasa, Emu, Nene, and Rui come to watch or join us in our shows, they're always smiling too, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And then when we see them smile, the plushies and myself will break out into huge grins too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: See? A neverending loop of smiles♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha, you're absolutely right.
Thank you, Miku!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well then! We'll have to keep this momentum going, and continue making great shows together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So that this loop of smiles never stops going!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, let's do our best! Whoo!
